title: COMPUTER AIDED DESIGN AND MANUFACTURING
description: Introduces students to the application of computer aided engineering tools across the extended product design and manufacturing cycle. Students become familiar with new product development and working in a sustaining engineering environment with an emphasis on using computer-aided design (CAD) and computer-aided manufacturing (CAM) tools to gain competitive advantage.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: ENGR 248 and (IE 366, ME 382 or 382H).
A minimum grade of C is required in ENGR 248, IE 366, ME 382 and ME 382H.
